name: Marcus T.
text: Been DCA-ing into BTC for 18 months now and the math checks out. The emotional discipline part is harder than people think though.

name: Sarah K.
text: Great breakdown of the volatility smoothing effect. Question: does this strategy still hold if you're automating buys across multiple altcoins, or is that just amplifying risk?

name: David R.
text: The problem with DCA is opportunity cost. You could've dumped everything at the local bottom instead of spreading buys. This article glosses over that.

name: Elena G.
text: Finally someone doing the actual math instead of just cheerleading. The comparison to traditional index funds was helpful for context.

name: James P.
text: Curious if your model accounts for exchange fees eroding returns on smaller purchases. That's killed my DCA returns more than volatility has.
